items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels ruled out with left elbow injury (dislocated); X-rays negative no fracture, expected to miss time (last instance ~4 games/month).
items.why: Dislocated left elbow after awkward fall; additional testing Monday.
items.implication: Miss multiple weeks; backup QB situation critical for WAS pass catchers.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is active today despite cracked rib.
items.why: Practiced Friday, improved steadily, Rap optimism he can go with flak jacket.
items.implication: WR2 with injury docks for reduced snaps/routes.
items.opportunity: Still primary target share if limited.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey is inactive today.
items.implication: Opens work for backups in DEN backfield.

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak on TE Brock Bowers: “Close, very close. He looks great.” (inactive Week 2 after knee/meniscus).
items.why: Returned to practice Friday post-meniscus repair; expected possible return next week.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans has a hip injury and is questionable to return today.
Bears say Caleb Williams suffered a hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring; walking under own power postgame, tests Monday.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE. RJ Harvey inactive. (If you ignored me in the preseason, please grab Jonah Coleman now). Agrees Bernard stash (YAC/McCarthy fit) with Pittman out.
items.why: Confirmed actives/inactives; preseason stash call on Coleman.

items.text: Eagles say RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) is questionable to return today.
items.implication: Monitor return; potential limited or exit.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow, listed as questionable, officially is active vs. the Texans.
items.why: Back soreness resolved enough to play.

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks; RapSheet tone bullish, official status late. Puka true GTD; Olave clean no docks; Harvey doubtful opens Coleman look; Pittman out opens Bernard look.
items.why: Rap bullish on McConkey flak; usage data implied for backups.
items.implication: McConkey startable with docks; stash Coleman/Bernard.
Opens targets for Bateman and others in BAL.
items.opportunity: Increased route/target share for remaining WRs.

items.implication: Target vacuum in IND; stash upside for YAC fits.

items.text: After nine receptions for 155 yards and three touchdowns today, Seahawks WR Smith-Njigba is now the fifth wide receiver ever with at least eight catches, 120 receiving yards and a touchdown reception in each of his team’s first two games.
